architecture_decisions.statement: Allocate 60 foundation slots as 6 governed modes across 10 validated L02 OPI.
Allocate 12 integrative slots 61-72 using only validated L02 material and the listed controlled focuses.
Use the six modes RECOGNIZE_INTENT, REPEAT_FORM, PRODUCE_QUESTION_OR_VALIDATED_SEQUENCE, TRACE_GIDS, CONTROLLED_RESPONSE_OR_BOUNDARY, MICRO_EXCHANGE_OR_CONTEXT_REHEARSAL.
For OPI-006, replace learner response production with boundary recognition and context rehearsal; do not invent a yes/no response.
For OPI-010, preserve the validated course sequence only; do not infer discourse grammar.

governance_decisions.statement: Source review does not author any Activation payload or HNK form.
PA remains lexical 'ontem'; OPI-008 and STR005 do not establish generic past, temporal syntax or DID auxiliary.
PITSA remains controlled loanword only; no borrowing grammar is created.
WATCH/CANDIDATE/FROZEN authority remains unchanged; AN/EN/KUVAN/KU/KE remain scoped teachable forms.
VANI and VANUVALI remain unresolved and excluded; G-ID remains structural authority and Candidate D remains non-canonical visual.
If approved, prepare a separate Activation authoring gate; do not author any of the 72 slots with the same approval.
